# Ruby documentation samples

These pages contain method comments from Ruby 3.4.0, commit
[`f45010833071b953744658842369e3496dfacb48`](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/tree/f45010833071b953744658842369e3496dfacb48).
Each page adds its method name as an RDoc heading and removes the C comment
delimiters, leading `*` characters and common comment indentation.
The comment text is otherwise unchanged.

| File | Original source and function |
| --- | --- |
| `enum_grep.rdoc` | [enum.c](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/blob/f45010833071b953744658842369e3496dfacb48/enum.c), `enum_grep` |
| `enum_filter_map.rdoc` | [enum.c](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/blob/f45010833071b953744658842369e3496dfacb48/enum.c), `enum_filter_map` |
| `rb_str_scan.rdoc` | [string.c](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/blob/f45010833071b953744658842369e3496dfacb48/string.c), `rb_str_scan` |

Ruby's [COPYING](COPYING) and [BSDL](BSDL) apply to these samples. Tests read
the checked-in files without contacting GitHub. Changes to a sample should name
the upstream commit and preserve its original code and prose.
